### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough. Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the order to avoid mistakes. | # | What to Do | Why It Matters | Tips | |---|------------|----------------|------| | 1 | **Plan & Budget** | Decide what you’ll use it for (gaming, video editing, office, etc.) and set a budget. | Use online PC builders (PCPartPicker, BuildMyPC) to compare prices and check compatibility. | | 2 | **Choose Components** | Pick CPU, motherboard, RAM, GPU, storage, PSU, case, cooling, and peripherals. | • **CPU + Motherboard**: Match socket (e.g., LGA 1700 for Intel 12th‑gen).
• **RAM**: DDR5/DDR4, 16 GB is a good baseline.
• **GPU**: Depends on workload; 3060/3070 for gaming, RTX 4090 for 4K.
• **Storage**: NVMe SSD for OS + SSD/HDD combo for bulk.
• **PSU**: 80+ Gold, 650–850 W (or more for high‑end GPUs).
• **Case**: ATX mid‑tower, ensure airflow and cable management. | | 3 | **Gather Tools & Workspace** | 1‑1/4” Phillips screwdriver, anti‑static wrist strap (optional), clean, flat surface. | Keep screws organized (use a magnetic tray or labeled containers). | | 4 | **Prepare the Case** | Remove side panels, lay the case face‑down on a non‑metal surface. | Check for any pre‑installed standoffs or screws that need removal. | | 5 | **Install the Power Supply** | Align PSU with rear mounting holes, secure with screws. | Route cables early: keep them tidy, use cable ties. | | 6 | **Mount the Motherboard** | Place standoffs in the case, align motherboard with I/O shield, screw down. | Double‑check that all standoffs match the motherboard’s layout. | | 7 | **Install the CPU** | Open the CPU socket latch, align the CPU (gold triangle) correctly, close latch. | Avoid touching the pins or contacts. | | 8 | **Apply Thermal Paste & Install CPU Cooler** | If cooler doesn’t have pre‑applied paste, apply a pea‑size amount. Attach cooler per its instructions. | Ensure the cooler is firmly seated; use the correct mounting hardware. | | 9 | **Insert RAM** | Open the DIMM slots, align the notch, press until clicks. | Install in pairs for dual‑channel (e.g., slot 1 & 3). | | 10 | **Mount the Storage** | 2.5″ SSDs go in drive bays or M.2 slots; 3.5″ HDDs need brackets. | Secure with screws or tool‑free brackets. | | 11 | **Install the GPU** | Remove the appropriate rear expansion slot covers, insert GPU into PCI‑e x16 slot, secure with screws. | Connect required PCI‑e power cables from PSU. | | 12 | **Connect Power Cables** | 24‑pin ATX, 8‑pin EPS, PCI‑e power, SATA power for drives, case front‑panel connectors. | Refer to motherboard manual for exact pinouts. | | 13 | **Connect Front Panel & USB** | Attach power button, reset, USB, audio, and other headers. | Use the motherboard manual’s diagram to avoid mis‑wiring. | | 14 | **Cable Management** | Tidy up cables, route them through cable‑management holes, use ties. | Good airflow = better cooling. | | 15 | **Double‑Check Everything** | Verify all screws, cables, and components are seated. | Turn off power before touching anything. | | 16 | **Power On & BIOS** | Connect monitor, keyboard, power cable. Press power button. | First boot should show BIOS/UEFI screen. | | 17 | **Update BIOS** | If needed, download latest BIOS from motherboard site, flash via USB. | Follow manufacturer instructions carefully. | | 18 | **Install Operating System** | Create bootable USB (Windows 10/11, Ubuntu, etc.), boot from it, install OS. | Install drivers after OS installation (chipset, GPU, Wi‑Fi). | | 19 | **Install Software & Drivers** | Install essential software (office, browsers, antivirus). | Keep drivers up‑to‑date via manufacturer sites or Windows Update. | | 20 | **Test & Benchmark** | Run stress tests (Prime95, 3DMark, Cinebench) to ensure stability. | Monitor temperatures (HWMonitor, MSI Afterburner). | | 21 | **Enjoy & Maintain** | Keep dust out, update firmware, monitor temperatures. | Clean case every 3–6 months. | --- #### Quick Checklist - [ ] CPU + Cooler - [ ] Motherboard + Standoffs - [ ] RAM - [ ] GPU - [ ] Storage (SSD/HDD) - [ ] PSU - [ ] Case - [ ] Cables (power, SATA, USB, front panel) - [ ] Thermal paste - [ ] Screwdriver set - [ ] Anti‑static wrist strap (optional) #### Common Pitfalls | Issue | Fix | |-------|-----| | **CPU not seated** | Re‑open socket, align correctly, close latch. | | **GPU not fully inserted** | Push firmly until it clicks; check for obstruction. | | **No POST** | Check power cables, remove all peripherals except keyboard & monitor. | | **Overheating** | Ensure cooler is properly mounted, check fan orientation, improve airflow. | | **Bad power supply** | Test with another PSU or use a PSU tester. | --- ### Resources - **PCPartPicker** – component compatibility checker, price comparison. - **YouTube Channels** – Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents, Paul's Hardware. - **Manufacturer Manuals** – always keep the motherboard, PSU, and GPU manuals handy. Happy building! If you hit a snag, let me know which step and I’ll help troubleshoot.
